svg.title: Terraform plan
svg.desc: 47 resources (7 cards), 44 relationships. Lines show architectural relationships. Edge titles identify the relationship kind and Terraform change. Thin solid: dependency. Dashed: association. Thick dotted: connection. Nested boxes: containment. Edge color preserves the Terraform action when available.

g.text: Line color shows the relationship's own Terraform action, independently of endpoint-card actions.
no independent change: no separate Terraform action is identified. unchanged: an explicit no-op action.
Dashed line from a Route to
Hollow circles mark resource/card attachment points; neither end of an undirected line is a directional start. Filled internal
Matching [N] badges identify the same Terraform-backed relationship and its Relationship Resources entry. They do not express
direction or count connections. Reference-only Connections and Dependencies have no number.
